summary: Turn DORA requirements into ICT risk, incident and provider oversight processes. Review the practitioner-focused course and plan your team’s training.
lede: DORA training helps financial-sector ICT risk, compliance and resilience professionals turn requirements into operational controls and evidence. Through practical exercises, they map ICT risks to controls, classify incidents, maintain third-party risk records, draft reporting workflows and management actions, and assess the scope of threat-led penetration testing.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who own or support DORA implementation across financial entities and critical ICT service relationships. It suits intermediate practitioners who work with ICT risk, compliance, security or resilience processes and need to translate regulatory obligations into operational evidence.
prerequisites: Prior experience in financial-sector ICT, cybersecurity, operational resilience, risk management or compliance is expected. No coding or programming is required. Advanced technical topics, including TLPT, are covered at operational application level; the course does not train you to execute penetration tests.
